prior_full_sphinx_baseline.note: Historical full-build baseline retained for context; not rerun after the v10 namespace/capability refactor in this runtime.

sync_pipeline_guarantees: author handle/tags/fields survive provider refresh by video id
unchanged normalized output is idempotent and writes are atomic
no-key partial RSS preserves unmatched history and unobserved richer provider fields
ordinary keyed sync preserves unmatched records; removal requires explicit --prune
provider acquisition is bounded by the 5,000-record catalog ceiling
current_v10_checks.documentation_static: passed: README/examples + 14 dependency-free public docstrings; Sphinx-dependent portion skipped

v10_architecture.youtube_gallery_role: typed video/channel adapter over one gallery-grid root
v10_architecture.channel_projection: :view: channels derives a deterministic offline channel index from video catalogs with stable channel identity
v10_architecture.custom_metadata: fields: exposes validated presentation-neutral metadata to shared group/filter/sort/search paths
v10_architecture.typed_export: video collections export videos: exact IDs; channel collections export channels: canonical HTTPS roots; no format selector
v10_architecture.channel_identity: video records separate human-facing channel from optional linkable handle/channel_id
v10_architecture.sync_ownership: YouTube refreshes provider metadata; authored handle/tags/fields survive by video id; partial RSS is non-pruning
v10_architecture.typed_search: accessible link prose remains accessible but is excluded from default typed search corpus
v10_architecture.show_count: youtube-gallery forwards the same explicit :show-count: contract as gallery-grid
v10_architecture.leaf_player_options: standalone youtube and generated gallery players share validators and privacy semantics

limitations: Full Sphinx/docutils/sphinx-design/MyST integration builds were not rerun because those packages are not installed and package-index access is unavailable in the current execution environment.
Sphinx-dependent resource/input fixtures were therefore not rerun; dependency-free bounds/model/sync checks and real Chromium DOM/runtime checks were rerun.
Live YouTube network/playback and cross-theme device testing were not performed; browser tests intentionally exercised local DOM/runtime behavior without relying on provider availability.
